'''Signal jammer Alpha''' was the designation of a [[Jammer/Legends|signal jammer]] used by the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] during the [[Separatist War|civil war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TOR" />

The jammer was set up along with two others, [[Signal Jammer Beta|signal jammers Beta]] and [[Signal Jammer Delta|Delta]], in the small settlement known as [[Drelliad village]] which the Separatists controlled for a period during the war. Here it was used to block transmissions between [[Republic Army]] forces assaulting the village and [[Fort Garnik]], the nearby Republic military stronghold. One of the Republic soldiers sent to capture Drelliad, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Jendan Blyes|Blyes]], discovered the blocking of his transmissions and searched for a way to disable the jammers.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Blyes asked a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|member]] of [[Havoc Squad]] and a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] to destroy the signal jammers for him and the pair accepted. They fought their way into the town and killed the Separatists guarding the jammers before disabling all three of them. They then returned to Blyes, who could now send intel to Fort Garnik, and were rewarded by him for their help.<ref name="TOR" />{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Signal jammer Alpha first appeared in the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
The jammer is one of three objectives players must interact with in an optional quest available for low level [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] on the starting [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for these classes, [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
